largeheadline.line1:
Collagen dura membrane

To ensure safety and quality, products are comprised of Type I collagen and intact dermis tissue derived from a safe, reliable bovine source.

text_1971668492_copy.text:
Overview

DuraMatrix-Onlay Conform is derived from purified, bovine Achilles tendon. It is intended for use as a dura substitute for repair of the dura mater. This implant has a thick, spongy texture and can be placed directly over the dural defect with or without sutures. DuraMatrix-Onlay Conform is intended to be applied as an onlay graft.

text.text:
Ease of use

Textured top surface that allows for easy grip and manipulation.

text_1538607969.text:
Balanced resorption & tissue ingrowth1

Promotes proliferation and ingrowth of fibroblasts, making it a favorable dural substitute.1

text_329460260.text:
Leak resistant2

Demonstrated protection against cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) leakage.2

text_438510401.text:
Biocompatible

Derived from highly purified type I collagen.

text_1971668492_copy.text:
Overview

DuraMatrix Repair delivers the reliability neurosurgeons demand. Made from highly purified fetal bovine dermis, this next-generation collagen graft is purpose-built to support strong, dependable dural reconstruction. Backed by sixth-generation engineering, DuraMatrix Repair provides a biocompatible,1 high-strength matrix1 that handles beautifully in the OR – conforming to complex contours while offering exceptional suture pull-out1 resistance. As it integrates, the matrix supports cellular and vascular ingrowth supporting the new collagen.2

text.text:
Right-sized

At 0.6mm thickness,1 it is comparable to native dura helping to provide increased confidence near critical anatomy.

text_12573780.text:
Conformable

DuraMatrix Repair offers responsive handling with exceptional
conformability and tear resistance.

text_2018533727.text:
Ease of use

DuraMatrix Repair hydrates rapidly with sterile saline. It trims
cleanly both dry and hydrated.

text_880069859.text:
Flexible performance

DuraMatrix Repair is highly conformable to adapt to intricate
cranial anatomy. It's built to function as a suturable graft, giving you control, stability and peace of mind.

text_1971668492_copy.text:
Overview

DuraMatrix Suturable is a collagen dura membrane derived from purified intact bovine dermis tissue, and is intended for use as a dura substitute for the repair of dura mater. This third generation DuraMatrix product uses a proprietary cross-linking technology to produce a strong, reliable collagen matrix with excellent conformability that is intended to be applied as a suturable graft. The matrix acts as a scaffold for the ingrowth of fibroblasts and blood vessels that results in the break down of the graft and formation of new collagen.1

text.text:
Reliable strength

Highest mechanical strength in the DuraMatrix portfolio.2,4

text_12573780.text:
Balanced resorption & tissue repair

Approximately 38-40 week resorption time that occurred at a balanced rate to support host tissue repair.3,4

text_2018533727.text:
Leak resistant

Demonstrates effective protection against CSF leakage.3,4

text_880069859.text:
Ease of use

Hydrates in 60 seconds and can be trimmed dry or hydrated.2,4

text_1971668492_copy.text:
Overview

DuraMatrix-Onlay is a white, nonfriable, conformable and resorbable, membrane matrix engineered from highly purified type I collagen derived from bovine Achilles tendon. It has thickness similar to that of native dura and is flexible and conforms to the contours of the defect site. DuraMatrix-Onlay is indicated as a dura substitute for the repair of dura mater.

text_copy.text:
Conformable

DMO is conformable and conforms to the natural contours of the defect site.

text_copy_625933902.text:
Balanced resorption & tissue repair

24-36 weeks resorption that occurs at a balanced rate to support host tissue repair.2,3

text_copy_1533144555.text:
Leak resistant

Demonstrates effective protection against CSF leakage.2,3

text_copy_419449995.text:
Ease of use

Hydrates in 30 seconds and can be trimmed dry or hydrated.1

text_1971668492_copy.text:
Overview

DuraMatrix-Onlay PLUS is derived from purified, bovine Achilles tendon. It is intended for use as a dura substitute for the repair of dura mater. In addition to the thick, spongy texture, this fourth-generation DuraMatrix product has a minimally porous, collagen layer. This layer helps produce a lower liquid permeability rate compared to that of DuraGen Plus as shown in a bench test.1,3 DuraMatrix-Onlay PLUS offers a balanced resorption profile that occurs over approximately 8 weeks.2,3

text_copy.text:
Leak resistant

One surface is smooth and minimally porous, demonstrating effective protection against CSF leakage.1,2,3

text_1259747248_copy.text:
Balanced resorption & tissue repair

Resorption time of approximately 8 weeks occurred at a balanced rate to support host tissue repair.2,3

text_942364874_copy.text:
Conformability

Sponge-like product that is designed to conform to the natural contours of the defect site.

text_629164029_copy.text:
Biocompatible

Derived from highly purified type I collagen.
